label: Bible Study
prompt: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a _____, and there is none abiding.
verse: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.
note: David, near the end of his reign, admits that kings are just passing through too.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I will give you _____ according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
verse: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
note: God promises 'pastors according to mine heart' — shepherds who feed with knowledge.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Greet all the brethren with an holy _____.
verse: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
note: Paul's closing instruction: greet the brethren with an holy kiss — he says it in four different letters.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force _____.
verse: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
note: At 120, Moses still had sharp eyes and full strength — he didn't fade out, he was simply called home.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: A good name is better than _____ ointment; and the day of death than the day of one's birth.
verse: A good name is better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one's birth.
note: A good name beats 'precious ointment' — and in Hebrew the two words even sound alike: shem and shemen.
